description: This file contains functions and types related to resolving workspace directories and agent IDs for a system, including handling fallbacks and sanitization.

classes.name: ResolveRunWorkspaceResult
classes.description: Type representing the result of resolving a workspace directory, including fallback info and agent details.

methods.name: resolveRunAgentId
methods.description: Resolves the agent ID and its source based on provided session key, explicit ID, or defaults.

methods.name: redactRunIdentifier
methods.description: Redacts an identifier string to a fixed length for privacy or logging.

methods.name: resolveRunWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Resolves the workspace directory path, applying sanitization and fallback logic as needed.
